shows.description:
Gold Roger was known as the Pirate King, the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line. The capture and death of Roger by the World Government brought a change throughout the world. His last words before his death revealed the location of the greatest treasure in the world, One Piece. It was this revelation that brought about the Grand Age of Pirates, men who dreamed of finding One Piece (which promises an unlimited amount of riches and fame), and quite possibly the most coveted of titles for the person who found it, the title of the Pirate King.

Enter Monkey D. Luffy, a 17-year-old boy that defies your standard definition of a pirate. Rather than the popular persona of a wicked, hardened, toothless pirate who ransacks villages for fun, Luffy’s reason for being a pirate is one of pure wonder; the thought of an exciting adventure and meeting new and intriguing people, along with finding One Piece, are his reasons of becoming a pirate. Following in the footsteps of his childhood hero, Luffy and his crew travel across the Grand Line, experiencing crazy adventures, unveiling dark mysteries and battling strong enemies, all in order to reach One Piece.

shows.description:
Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.

Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home.

During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.

shows.description: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls. The plots are more like "Today, Sazae-san goes to the new mall and gets lost". Such "boring" plotlines and the simplistic art are often a turn-off to non-Japanese audiences, but most Japanese find the show incredibly good. As a result, it continues to be one of the top ratings grabbers on TV and is one of the few anime that is considered "acceptable" by adults.

summaries.21: Gold Roger, the legendary Pirate King, left behind a treasure called One Piece before his execution, sparking a golden age where countless pirates set out to find it. Monkey D. Luffy, a cheerful seventeen-year-old with rubber powers, sets sail with his growing crew not for riches alone but for the thrill of adventure and meeting unforgettable people along the way. It's a sprawling, good-natured pirate epic built on found family, wild imagination, and battles against increasingly strange enemies.
summaries.235: Shinichi Kudo is a brilliant teenage detective known as the Modern Sherlock Holmes, until a shadowy organization poisons him and leaves him shrunk into the body of a child. Hiding his true identity, he moves in with his childhood friend Ran and her bumbling detective father, solving a steady stream of murders while quietly hunting the people who did this to him. It blends mystery-of-the-week cases with a long-running conspiracy simmering underneath.
summaries.966: Follows the everyday chaos caused by Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara, a five-year-old with an uncanny talent for embarrassing his parents, neighbors, and teachers in the town of Kasukabe. Much of the humor comes from his bizarre, inappropriate turns of phrase and general disregard for how a small child is supposed to behave. It's an episodic family comedy that leans hard into silly, cringe-inducing gags rather than any ongoing story.
summaries.1199: Rantarou, Shinbei, and Kirimaru are first-year students at a ninja academy, more interested in food, money, and goofing off than mastering their craft. Each half-hour episode is split into two short, comedic segments following their misadventures alongside teachers, classmates, and a rival group of ninjas. It's a gentle, episodic gag comedy aimed at kids rather than a serialized ninja drama.
summaries.1960: When a falling Star of Life brings bread dough to life in a forest bakery, it becomes Anpanman, a gentle superhero made of sweet bean-filled bread. Alongside his friends, he faces off against his rival Baikinman while helping anyone who's hungry. A long-running, warmhearted series built for very young viewers, mixing simple heroics with comfort-food charm.
summaries.2406: Centers on Sazae-san, a mother living in a multi-generational household with her husband, child, siblings, and parents, going about ordinary domestic life. Plots are deliberately small-scale, things like a trip to a new mall going sideways, rendered in simple, old-fashioned art. It's a gentle, long-running family sitcom with no violence, edge, or fantasy elements.
summaries.4459: Bored with his pampered life in Heian-era Japan, young noble Ojarumaru stumbles onto a magic stick stolen from the demon king and uses it to leap into the present day. Taken in by a boy named Kazuma, he settles into a new life full of everyday mischief, while three bumbling demons chase him trying to get the stick back. A gentle, episodic comedy about an odd little prince adjusting to modern life.
summaries.6149: Momoko, nicknamed Chibi Maruko-chan for her small size, is an ordinary elementary schooler who loves idols and manga, living with her parents, grandparents, and older sister in a small town. Each episode follows her and her classmates through the small joys and awkward moments of everyday school life. A cozy, nostalgic slice-of-life comedy about growing up in an unremarkable, lovable town.
summaries.8336: Hanakappa follows a colorful cast of kappa, folklore creatures traditionally tied to water, each one identifiable by a single flower blooming from the top of their head. Beyond that central design, no plot specifics are given, so the show's appeal seems to rest on this whimsical visual hook and its light, character-driven charm rather than an elaborate ongoing story. It reads as a gentle, playful concept likely aimed at young viewers.
summaries.8687: A fresh adaptation of the long-running Doraemon franchise, produced by the same team behind the original 1979 series in association with Studio Pierrot. It brings new voice actors, staff, and updated character designs to the familiar robotic-cat premise.
summaries.10506: Taneko is a cat who travels around answering people's wishes and delivering small moments of happiness wherever she goes. Built around a gentle, feel-good premise, the series follows her rounds as an easygoing, family-friendly comfort watch.
summaries.18941: The fourth season of the Shimajirou children's television series, continuing as a new installment in the same long-running franchise for young viewers.
summaries.21552: A fresh retelling of the gentle adventures shared by three forest friends: a soft-spoken sea otter, an easily excitable squirrel, and a raccoon. Together they wander their woodland home, turning small everyday moments into quiet, whimsical adventures for a new generation of viewers.
summaries.101184: A collection of short promotional animations made for the Fate/Grand Order mobile game, aired on TV and posted to Type-Moon's YouTube channel to advertise the game or promote new in-game events. The animation in each commercial is original and doesn't appear in the game or the wider Fate/Grand Order anime series, making this a curiosity for franchise completists rather than a standalone story.
summaries.101906: Ratio is a girl living in a snow-covered world alongside her shaggy companion Jammon. Each episode finds her learning something new from the spirits and people she meets along the way, in a gentle, episodic series built around small discoveries.
summaries.102763: A collection of short vignettes capturing bittersweet, tender moments of everyday family life, produced as a commercial series for a miso soup brand. Each mini-story finds warmth in small domestic scenes, meals shared, distances crossed, quiet care between generations, rather than following one continuous plot.
summaries.110694: A special anthology project pairing acclaimed Japanese animation studios and comic creators to imagine fictional Paralympic athletes as animated heroes. Conceived to spotlight Paralympic sports ahead of the Tokyo Games, each segment introduces its own character and sport, aiming to make new athletic heroes accessible through anime storytelling.
summaries.113863: A short anime following a boy named Tarou as he transforms into the superhero Gainaman. A compact, hero-of-the-week style premise aimed at a young audience.
summaries.116787: Koyan the Origami Ninja arrives on Earth from his home planet Origamio, searching for a magical stone called Hapiton that can make people happy. Joined by his childhood friend Namin and a new ally, Lublin, he finds his search constantly disrupted by the mysterious villain Evilrun, whose stomach hides a black hole that swallows anything nearby. A whimsical sci-fi adventure with a search-and-rescue backbone and a recurring comic antagonist.
summaries.118123: Follows the eccentric cast of Hololive's virtual YouTubers as they stumble through absurd, everyday mishaps around the office, from mysterious doors to surprise packages that turn out to be bombs. It's a lighthearted comedy built around the VTubers' established personalities rather than any larger plot.
summaries.119080: A collection of short promotional animations for the mobile game Arknights, produced for TV and the game's official YouTube channel to advertise the title and its in-game events after its Japan launch. The animation is exclusive to these commercials and isn't found elsewhere in the game, making this a niche collection for fans of the franchise's visual side.
summaries.121080: An original anime series produced in cooperation with Kanagawa Prefecture in Japan, made as a direct partnership between the production and the regional government.
summaries.124082: A collection of original animated promotional videos made for the Azur Lane mobile game, each featuring animation unique to the commercials themselves and not seen in the game or its separate TV series. Rather than telling one continuous story, the shorts serve as stylish, standalone vignettes spotlighting the game's characters and settings.
summaries.128394: A mini-anime built around Shikaruneko, the Angry Cat character created by illustration agency wwwaap, bringing the popular character design to animated shorts on TV Tokyo.
summaries.129963: A pair of teaser videos introducing hololive Alternative, described as another possible world for the Hololive VTuber franchise. They're brief promotional glimpses rather than a full story.
summaries.134107: The second season of Wu Shang Shen Di, continuing the story directly from where the first season left off. Its listing gives no further plot details, so newcomers may want to start with the original season first.
summaries.136862: The cosmos is split between a demon-ruled outer universe and an inner universe layered into divine, eternal, and mortal realms, each containing countless smaller worlds like the Tianfa Continent. Nine immortal emperors preside over the mortal layer, with an even higher realm of purified gods above them. A sprawling xianxia setting built for grand-scale cultivation and celestial power struggles.
summaries.137653: Wang Lin is an ordinary young man from the countryside who chooses to pursue immortality, driven less by a desire for long life than by resentment toward the powerful forces that look down on people like him. With middling natural talent but a sharp mind, he claws his way up through the cultivation world over a long, hard-won journey. It's a classic underdog cultivation story built on grit rather than natural gifts.
summaries.137671: Opening on the myth of nine dragons and an ancient coffin, the story unfolds across a vast primeval world as protagonist Ye Fan begins climbing his way toward the heavens. A classic xianxia journey of cultivation and ambition set against sweeping, mythic scenery.
summaries.137683: Set generations after the founding of the Tang Sect, a once-great martial arts clan now in decline, this follows a prodigiously talented newcomer and a new generation of Shrek's Seven Monsters as they try to restore the sect's former glory. Ancient soul beasts, hidden weapons, and long-buried secrets from the sect's decline complicate their path. It's a martial-arts fantasy about reviving a fallen legacy.
summaries.138416: A collection of animated promotional videos for the mobile game Blue Archive, released periodically to accompany in-game events and anniversaries. They're short, stylish tie-in pieces rather than a connected narrative.
summaries.140842: Follows the small, sometimes happy and sometimes stressed daily life of Chiikawa, a tiny, endearingly cute creature getting by in a world of odd jobs and small pleasures. Alongside friends like bees and rabbits, Chiikawa works hard, eats well, and keeps smiling through it all. It's a gentle, bite-sized comedy about finding contentment in small routines.
summaries.142274: In the near future, the ninja clans that once shaped Japan's history have scattered and thinned across generations. Their descendants form the WNA to preserve that legacy, eventually developing Ninja-Gum, a substance that channels ninja power, and holding the Ninjala Tournament to find whichever fighter carries the strongest ninja bloodline. An action series built around a game-inspired, high-energy martial tournament.
summaries.143103: Aoko Aozaki is an ordinary high school girl by day, but she's secretly an apprentice Magician living in the modern world. While she shares a home with fellow apprentice Alice Kuonji and works toward becoming a full magician, a chance meeting with a boy sets her story in motion. A moody, atmospheric coming-of-age tale steeped in a blend of everyday life and hidden magic.
summaries.144779: A new entry in the Space Battleship Yamato franchise, serving as a direct sequel to the film Uchuu Senkan Yamato 2205: Aratanaru Tabidachi. Plot specifics beyond its place in the ongoing film series aren't detailed yet.
summaries.146004: A weekly series of comedic short videos starring VTuber Watame, released every Friday on her YouTube channel. Lighthearted, bite-sized entertainment built around her established comic persona.
summaries.151778: After three years locked away, a cultivator returns to the world having mastered seven of the strongest bloodlines, dozens of peak techniques, and elite mystical arts, only to discover his spirit animal is, of all things, a pig. A comedic spin on the overpowered-cultivator genre, playing its protagonist's absurd mismatch for laughs.
summaries.152181: Koguma no Yuugo is a collection of short video clips centered on the character Yugo, posted directly to animator Tomoyasu Murata's YouTube channel. Rather than telling one continuous story, it offers a series of brief, standalone pieces best suited to viewers who enjoy dipping into quick bursts of animation between other watching.
summaries.152677: The second season of Tantei wa mou, Shindeiru., continuing the story from the first season. Its listing gives no further plot or tone details for this continuation.
summaries.153843: NoriPro Anime introduces the VTuber group NoriPro through an original 3D animated project built entirely in-house, from animation to voice acting to story. Rather than adapting an existing work, it's conceived from scratch as a way to bring the group's virtual idol personas to life on screen, aimed at fans of VTuber culture curious to see these characters animated for the first time.
summaries.155723: The second season of Wushen Zhuzai, picking up the ongoing story from its first installment, titled Da Wei Pian. No additional plot details are provided beyond it being a direct continuation.
summaries.157330: A sequel film to the 2014 movie Expelled From Paradise, continuing that story in theaters. Its listing doesn't offer further plot or tone details beyond being a follow-up.
summaries.158871: A new entry in the long-running Pokemon anime, following a girl named Liko and a boy named Roy as they set out across the wider Pokemon world. It promises the series' familiar mix of adventure and discovery under new leads.
summaries.159042: The second season of Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita, continuing the story from the first season. Episodes streamed a week ahead of its regular TV broadcast, which began October 8, 2026, but no further plot details are given.
summaries.159454: A Japan-exclusive spin on the classic Tom and Jerry cat-and-mouse chase, created to celebrate Japan's Cheese Day. It keeps the fast-paced slapstick of the original while adding a cuter, more pop-flavored art style, with diaper-wearing Tuffy Mouse joining the pair as a recurring third wheel.
summaries.160275: A sequel to Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou, continuing that story. Its listing provides no additional plot or tone details for this follow-up.
summaries.160803: An anime adaptation of the Magical Girl Raising Project franchise's "Restart" light novel volumes, with original series director Hiroyuki Hashimoto returning for this entry. Beyond confirming the franchise and creative team, no plot or tone details have been given yet.
summaries.165159: Bird Kazami dreams of becoming a professional Blader and gets his shot when he meets former champion Ekusu Kurosu, known as Kamen X, forming a team aimed at the top of the X Tower. Their path leads toward battles unlike anything seen before, powered by the newly unveiled, super-accelerated X Beyblades. It's a competitive shonen sports premise built around a fresh evolution of the Beyblade format.
summaries.165524: Across a hundred thousand years, generation after generation of disciples at the Tianlan Sect ascend to greater heights, masters, fellow students, even an old dog and a tree spirit, while one disciple, Xu Yang, quietly stays behind refining his own power for ten thousand years straight. When he finally breaks through, his long, patient wait pays off in an unexpected way. A slow-burn cultivation comedy about persistence outlasting talent.
summaries.166219: The fourth season of the long-running Tunshi Xingkong series, covering episodes 86 through 260 of its overall story. It continues directly from the prior season, with no further details given about what unfolds.
summaries.166444: Online, top-ranked swordsman Xiao Wujin and infamous outlaw Tao Zhiyaoyao are rivals in a popular game. Offline, they're actually campus heartthrob Xiao He and freshman Shen Xin, who grow close after meeting through a collegiate esports tournament. With their friend Yang Yao rounding out the team, the three chase a championship together while Xiao He and Shen Xin's relationship quietly deepens along the way.
summaries.168177: General Zichuan Xiu, once known for single-handedly striking down a traitor deep inside enemy territory, has risen to lead a massive allied army in the Far East. Backed by the Sacred Temple's elders, he now ascends to become the new ruler of the Eastern lands. A continuation of a war-and-politics fantasy centered on one warrior's rise to the throne.
summaries.169377: Kotarou, a Taiko-drumming enthusiast from Taiko Village, sets out with his partner Don-chan to spread the joy of taiko drumming across the world. A cheerful, music-driven adventure built around the rhythm game franchise of the same name.
summaries.169581: A devoted fan of the adult visual novel Magical Explorer wakes up reincarnated inside its world, not as the suave hero he expected, but as Kousuke Takioto, the game's awkward comic-relief best friend. Armed with insider knowledge of the game and Kousuke's odd scarf-based fighting style, he sets out to turn this underdog character into a winner. It plays as an isekai comedy leaning on game-logic gags and self-aware humor about its own genre.
summaries.170497: A series of short comedic videos starring VTuber Hakui Koyori, built around quick, punchy gags that go out with a bang. Bite-sized entertainment tied to her established online persona.
summaries.170660: The third season of Chickip Dancers, continuing the series from its earlier seasons. Its listing includes no further details about this season's content.
summaries.172192: The second season of Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu, continuing its story from the first season. No further plot or tone information is included in its listing.
summaries.176314: The second season of Sasaki to Pii-chan, picking up after the first season. Its listing gives no additional details about plot or tone for this continuation.
summaries.178083: A sequel to Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen, continuing the Tokyo Revengers story. Its listing offers no further plot or tone details beyond being a follow-up installment.
summaries.178125: When twelve amulets that protect the world are suddenly shattered, a curse begins spreading across everyone, except Rokuro, who remains strangely unaffected. Setting out with his older brother Goro and younger sister Nanako, and armed with a magic brush from a hermit, Rokuro begins a journey to save his family and, eventually, the whole world.
summaries.178868: Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu are three ordinary schoolgirls on a field trip to Tokyo Tower when they're suddenly summoned to the magical world of Cephiro. Princess Emeraude, the realm's Pillar, has called for Magic Knights to save her kingdom, and the three strangers must now master unfamiliar powers together. A bright, classic fantasy adventure about unlikely heroines thrown into a world of wonder.
summaries.178972: An anthology film collecting three original stories: a friendly alien ambassador navigating prejudice and curiosity about Earth culture, a group of lost girls competing in a nighttime Tokyo survival game, and a vampire traveling a post-apocalyptic world with the humans she's turned, finding quiet beauty in what's left behind. Three very different moods united by a shared grotesque, atmospheric style.
summaries.179860: A set of animated promotional videos made for Aikatsu Academy!, the Aikatsu franchise's virtual YouTuber project, released on the Streaming Club's YouTube channel to introduce its characters and world.
summaries.179876: Honoring his late grandfather's wish, Kairi travels to Golden Valley, a special economic zone built around the Dark Machine battle scene. There he meets the mysterious Rudra, who pulls him into competitive Dark Machine play, and his talent begins to grow through a string of intense matches. Part of a wider cross-media project blending the anime with a companion game.
summaries.179916: On a continent where spiritual and martial power both shape destiny, prodigy Chen Tian loses his gift and his spiritual reserves at age ten, becoming an outcast in his own family. After a near-fatal fall leads him into an ancient formation, he awakens a rare dual cultivation physique along with a mysterious memory and a strange storage ring. Rebuilding from nothing, he begins climbing back toward strength on a road built for a future champion.
summaries.180136: Born into a family of celebrated swordsmen, Elymas is cast out when he awakens the supposedly worthless Heavy Knight class. Disowned and adrift, he regains memories of a past life in which this very world was a VR game he'd mastered, giving him knowledge no one else has. He sets out to use that edge to rebuild his life and prove his so-called weak class wrong. A game-knowledge isekai revenge story.
summaries.180894: After helping defeat the Demon King, Romelia finds herself dismissed as dead weight for not fighting on the front lines, and her prince abruptly ends their engagement. Cast out by her family and shut out of the victory celebrations, she refuses to be broken and instead sets her sights on a new path forward. A story of quiet resilience after being discarded by the people she helped save.
summaries.183231: A laid-back bear named Rilakkuma drifts through cozy, low-stakes days filled with small comforts, quiet friendships, and gentle changes. Each episode leans into a soft, stress-free mood, following Rilakkuma's talent for making relaxation look effortless.
summaries.183473: The second season of Nui Story, continuing on from the first. No additional plot or tone details are provided in its listing.
summaries.184872: The second season of Nitian Xie Shen, covering episodes 31 through 82 of the overall story. It continues directly from the first season, with no further plot details provided.
summaries.185646: Koupen-chan follows a small penguin and friends through gentle, low-stakes everyday moments. It's built around warmth and simplicity rather than plot, the kind of show meant to unwind to.
summaries.185725: Junior student Ye Bufan tries to scam his way into cash to cover his mother's medical bills, only to run into a driver who refuses to play along. After the encounter goes wrong, he's unexpectedly pulled into a fantasy world where he inherits ancient medical knowledge. Balancing new healing skills with martial arts training, he begins carving out a very different life for himself.
summaries.185756: The third season of Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru, continuing its story from earlier seasons. Production for this season moved to studio GeyeG Pictures from MOTHER, though the same staff carries over; no plot details are given beyond that.
summaries.185874: The fourth and final part of BLEACH: Sennen Kessen-hen brings the Thousand-Year Blood War to its climax, as the Soul Reapers and Quincies clash across a world showing signs of collapse. Ichigo and his allies face escalating threats from Yhwach's forces as the fight for the survival of the Three Worlds reaches its peak. The concluding chapter of one of shonen's longest-running sagas, promising an all-out final confrontation.
summaries.186151: A monthly short-anime series spotlighting original card themes from the Yu-Gi-Oh! Official Card Game, expanding on a demo reel released the previous year. It's aimed squarely at OCG players and fans following new card archetypes rather than a standalone story.
summaries.186495: The third season of an ongoing interactive multimedia music project blending original songs with character-driven visuals, continuing the collaboration between composer DECO*27 and director Takuya Yamanaka. Each release centers on a different character's song and persona, building out the project's world one track at a time.
summaries.186541: Ordinary office worker and gamer Takahiro Sato wakes up aboard a spaceship that looks just like one from his favorite shooter game, fully equipped and crewed. With top-tier gear and an unexpected found family of companions, he sets out to explore the galaxy and build the freewheeling life he's always wanted. A breezy space adventure built on wish-fulfillment and found-family charm.
summaries.186742: In Academy City, where esper abilities are an everyday science, a hidden Dark Side quietly handles the missions that can never be made public. ITEM is an elite four-girl unit built for exactly that work: a tracker who senses psychic traces, a demolitions and trap specialist, a nitrogen-manipulating defender, and one of the city's strongest espers leading them. Friendship and darkness collide as their missions edge toward something bigger.
summaries.186837: A series of short episodes set in the Tian Guan Ci Fu world, presented in a compact, bite-sized format rather than a full-length narrative.
summaries.187316: Riliu and his best friend Jowy grow up together as soldiers for the Highland Kingdom, sharing the same hopes for peace once the fighting ends. Instead, the tides of war sweep them onto opposing paths, and each boy is drawn toward a legendary power tied to 108 scattered stars. A sweeping tale of friendship strained by fate and the different beliefs two young men are forced to choose between.
summaries.187402: Fia was born into a family of knights but is considered the least talented among them, training hard anyway to prove herself. A near-fatal encounter with a dragon unlocks memories of her previous life as a powerful Saint who once defeated the Demon King, a life that ended in pain because of what she was. Now she must decide whether to embrace that power again in order to survive as a knight.
summaries.187990: A new television anime entry in the long-running Battle Spirits franchise. Its listing gives no further detail about plot, characters, or tone.
summaries.188036: In a universe built on inequality by its own reckless creator, ordinary people get one shot at changing their fate: entering the brutal Aotu Tournament and using system-granted special abilities to survive round after round. After a hundred years dormant, the tournament reopens, and a young man named King enters hoping to change his home planet's fate and find his missing sister.
summaries.188753: Built around illustrator Yuri Yokomizo's character designs, this short anime follows the everyday lives of anything and everything, animals, plants, food, ordinary objects, treating each as its own small character. New shorts release monthly across social platforms like Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
summaries.189123: The second season of Ao no Hako, continuing the story from its first season. No further plot or tone details are included in its listing.
summaries.189717: Made to celebrate the announcement of a movie tied to the live-action Tokyo MER medical drama, this short anime reimagines its cast of emergency doctors as animals. A lighthearted companion piece that carries over the spirit of the original series in a cuter, more playful form.
summaries.190054: As their wedding day approaches, Miyo and Kiyoka's bond keeps deepening. When Miyo joins a cooking class alongside Hazuki, an unexpected reunion with an old classmate adds a new wrinkle to the preparations.
summaries.191656: At the elite Fujinasu Academy, first-year Ume Mizunoe excels in Japanese literature but is failing science badly enough to risk being held back, so he joins the student council to boost his grades. There he meets a sharp but moody council president, a gentle yet intimidating treasurer, and other quirky members, kicking off a warm, slapstick rom-com about an odd-couple student council.
summaries.191788: Having earned a spot on the elite A team, Aoi Ashito quickly discovers just how far he still has to go, facing a level of competition and pressure he's never experienced before. The second season follows his struggle to find his footing among the best players in the club. A grounded soccer drama about adjusting to a much bigger stage.
summaries.191832: The third season of Shiguang Dailiren, continuing the series from its earlier installments. No further plot details are given in its listing.
summaries.193414: A collection of short, slice-of-life vignettes following the members of MyGO!!!!! through their everyday routines. Rather than building toward a single story, each short offers a brief, low-stakes glimpse into how the group spends its downtime together. It's a breezy, easygoing companion piece best suited to viewers already attached to these characters, more about spending time with the cast than following a plot.
summaries.194207: Based on Keiko Shibata's picture books, Pan Dorobou follows a mischievous loaf of bread that sneaks around the city stealing bread from local bakeries. A lighthearted, whimsical premise built for a young audience, adapted from the beloved illustrated series.
summaries.195516: With the Shi Clan's rebellion settled, pharmacist Maomao returns to her quiet life in the pleasure district, until a strange detail at breakfast pulls her into another investigation. Jinshi, now carrying the weight of his true identity as the emperor's brother, is troubled by a cryptic warning of disaster facing the nation, while rumors of a deceptive shrine maiden spread unease. The mystery widens well beyond the court this season.
summaries.195539: Back in Night City, washed-up cyberpunk legend Weak now lives without chrome, searching for purpose in a world that has moved on without him. Meanwhile the ruthless nomad D pursues a path of revenge that draws him dangerously close to corporate secrets meant to stay buried. A standalone ten-episode story about family, obsession, and legacy in a city that chews people up.
summaries.195571: Masks crafted by the legendary Gaston Roux grant their wearers great power, for better or worse. After being overtaken by one such mask and causing a tragedy he can never undo, Gaston's pupil Peru sets out alone to track down and destroy every mask his master ever made. Along the way he meets new allies and dangerous enemies, each step bringing him closer to atoning for what he's done.
summaries.195604: As the Clover Kingdom falls under tyranny, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid into the Spade Kingdom to rescue their captured captains from the Dark Triad. The mission throws them into brutal fights against enemies stronger than anything they've faced, forcing Asta to push past his limits to protect his friends and keep the promise he made to Yuno.
summaries.195885: The fourth season of Shixiong A Shixiong, continuing the series' ongoing storyline. No further plot details are included in its listing.
summaries.196241: On Guuguu Island, every resident is a living dish from the Yakiniku King menu, meat, vegetables, sweets, and more. Calvin, an apprentice galbi, dreams of becoming the menu's most popular item, and flies around the universe with his friends chasing that goal. A colorful, food-themed adventure built around friendship and self-improvement.
summaries.196613: The eighth season of the long-running Dou Po Cangqiong series, covering episodes 158 through 219 of its overall story. It continues directly from the previous season, with no further synopsis given.
summaries.198560: In a world where sword-and-sorcery adventuring is old news but broadcast television is the new frontier, camera crews start turning their lenses toward dungeons once explored only by adventurers. Facing monsters and constant equipment trouble, these camera-wielding crews chase the first-ever live dungeon broadcast. A genre mashup of fantasy adventure and behind-the-scenes broadcast comedy.
summaries.198706: The second season of Da Zhuzai, covering episodes 53 through 104 of the overall story. It continues directly from the first season, with no additional plot details provided.
summaries.198708: The thirteenth season of the long-running Huyao Xiao Hongniang series, continuing its extended storyline. No further plot or tone details are given for this installment.
summaries.198727: The second part of Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka, continuing directly from the first part. Its listing provides no additional plot or tone details.
summaries.199007: To Aki and her friends, growing up in a ruined world overrun by zombies is still full of wonder, since it's the only world they've ever known. When Aki sets out with her childhood friends to find her missing father, the search quickly turns into a fight for survival beyond the safety of their small village. A coming-of-age adventure about discovery and danger in a post-apocalyptic setting.
summaries.199068: This special follows Team Japan's tennis players competing against each other to claim the final spots on the roster for the U-17 World Cup final. Long-standing rivalries resurface as teammates face off, turning the selection process itself into the main event rather than a match against an outside rival. It suits fans of competitive sports drama who enjoy high-stakes matches driven by personal history between the players.
summaries.199340: Popular actress Mai Sakurajima reveals she's secretly the mysterious internet singer everyone's been talking about, and the moment plays out exactly as Sakuta Azusagawa foresaw in a dream. As more impossible events start coming true and a strange hashtag connected to them vanishes, Sakuta receives a warning from an alternate version of himself urging him to find a woman named Touko Kirishima before reality itself gets rewritten.
summaries.199409: The fourth and final season of Yi Nian Yongheng, bringing the series' long-running story to its close. No further plot details are given beyond it concluding the series.
summaries.199426: The second season of Hotel Inhumans, continuing its story from the first season. No further plot or tone information is given in its listing.
summaries.199594: Misaki starts college still unsure what she wants to do with her life, but longing for something to be passionate about. Joining the Railway Travel Research Club introduces her to a group of enthusiastic members and sets her on a journey along real train lines across Japan. A gentle slice-of-life celebration of railways made for the Tetsudou Musume franchise's 20th anniversary.
summaries.200294: In the never-sleeping city of Chinjuku, psychic senior police officer Meguru Chojo has powers beyond ordinary comprehension, and he keeps the streets in line alongside his judo-expert partner Nao Ippongi. A fast, comedic buddy-cop series built around an absurdly overpowered hero and his very grounded partner.
summaries.200375: Built around temp agency Improve's mascot character Inpuru-kun, this series follows him taking on one absurd temp job after another. A lighthearted, gag-driven premise built around workplace comedy.
summaries.200455: Reborn as the villainess in a reverse-harem otome game, extremely timid Pia Rockwell has no interest in romance drama; she just wants to use her past-life knowledge of paleontology to dig up fossils and run a museum someday. To avoid the villainess's usual fate, she tries to call off her engagement to the prime minister's cunning son, Rufus, only to find he isn't ready to let her go so easily.
summaries.200929: An original movie set within the Kusuriya no Hitorigoto (The Apothecary Diaries) story, not adapted from an existing light novel arc. Beyond that, its listing gives no plot or tone details, and its franchise relations are still provisional.
summaries.202079: Mitsutaka Oji is a cool, capable 40-year-old who excels at his job and looks the part of an effortlessly stylish adult, except for one closely guarded secret: he's completely obsessed with cute, adorable things. A warm comedy following his everyday attempts to balance a polished image with his soft side.
summaries.202250: In a world of sword-and-sorcery adventuring, Lent's unique gift lets him lend huge amounts of magic power to his party members, making him indispensable right up until his now-formidable teammates decide they don't need him anymore. Kicked out and furious, Lent discovers a hidden side to his ability and sets out, with a mischievous fairy partner, to reclaim every bit of magic he ever gave away.
summaries.202390: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou series, continuing the story from the earlier installments. Its listing gives no further plot or tone details for this entry.
summaries.202851: The fifth season of Fanren Xiu Xian Zhuan, continuing the series from its earlier installments. No further plot details are provided for this entry.
summaries.202957: The 23rd installment of the Precure franchise follows Anna Akechi, a junior high student who meets a fairy named Pochitan on her 14th birthday and is suddenly thrown back in time from 2027 to 1999. There she befriends Mikuru Kobayashi, an aspiring detective, and the two transform into Precures to stop a wave of thefts by mysterious Phantom Thieves. A mystery-flavored entry in the magical-girl franchise, mixing detective work with time travel.
summaries.203275: Sixth-graders Yuuma and his twin sister Sawa are playing a new VR MMORPG when it suddenly starts merging with the real world, turning the game's dangers into genuine life-or-death threats. When Yuuma's classmate Sumika is transformed into one of the game's monstrous enemies, survival becomes the only objective in a reality where gaming and the real world are now one and the same.
summaries.203473: Urban legends have started coming to life across Japan, drawn out by sightings of a mysterious faceless girl. Anyone who crosses paths with her or the horrors she brings has little chance alone; their only hope is a boy in a red hood who hunts these legends down before it's too late. A supernatural horror series built around real urban-legend folklore made terrifyingly real.
summaries.203490: When her mother remarries during her first year of high school, Ito Hazui moves into a new household and suddenly finds herself with four younger step-brothers. She works hard to bond with her new family, even as the eldest, Gen, stays cool and distant on the surface. A family comedy about blending households and reading between someone's guarded exterior.
summaries.204011: High schooler Ageha Yoshina finds a strange red phone card left in a booth, and soon after, his classmate and childhood friend Sakurako, who had an identical card, vanishes without a trace. Searching for her pulls him into rumors of a secret organization called Psyren, tied to a wave of mysterious disappearances, and into a dangerous game that will change the course of his life.
summaries.204269: The second season of Odekake Kozame, continuing on from the first. No additional plot or tone details are given in its listing.
summaries.204389: The second season of Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta!, continuing its story from the first season. No additional plot or tone details are included in its listing.
summaries.204626: After the Speranza incident, humans and Metal Cardbots settle into an uneasy coexistence on Earth. Jun, a boy chosen by the Metal Breath, and his partner Blue Cop have found a way to keep that peace, until a Wild Cardbot appears, carrying a secret 60 million years in the making, and a new chapter of encounters begins to shake the world.
summaries.204650: Having grown stronger through battles in Kyoto and Nerima, the students of Rasetsu Academy face a new rift when Yaoroshi leaves to join the Oni Brigade's campaign against the Momotaro. When Shiki learns the Brigade is targeting civilians, he sets out to bring Yaoroshi back, while a secretive research facility near the old Kegon Falls hides experiments of its own.
summaries.204656: Shark Meow, an easygoing orange tabby who wears a shark costume, spends each day with his best kitty friends and a rescued baby cat named Little Meow. Their world is built from small, cozy moments, a warm park bench, the smell of roasted sweet potatoes, the season's first snowfall, turned into gentle, feel-good stories. A soft, slice-of-life comfort watch about finding joy in ordinary days.
summaries.204762: Enter the Garden is a three-part anthology series produced by Azuki and Dentsu, with veteran director Gorou Taniguchi serving as creative producer. Each part stands independently, letting the anthology format explore different ideas and styles rather than following one continuous story. It should appeal to viewers who enjoy short, creator-driven anime and want to see what a producer with Taniguchi's pedigree brings to the format.
summaries.205289: Years after the events of the original film, a young man has grown distant from his mother and struggles to be honest with her after returning to his hometown. Reuniting with Norman, he and his old friend meet a mysterious child searching for rare snow flowers and journey with them into a snow-covered forest. A quiet, wintry story about reconnecting with family and the past.
summaries.205896: RPG enthusiast Makoto Takatsuki is thrown into another world with disappointingly weak skills and stats, but his luck changes when he meets a goddess named Noah. She offers him blessings in exchange for becoming her very first believer, setting him on an isekai journey built around faith, growth, and an unlikely partnership with a deity in need of followers.
summaries.205909: Satoko is a noblewoman with beauty and status, but a terminal illness leaves her with little time to secure the marriage that would restore her family's standing. When the mysterious assassin Shinpei targets her, she makes a desperate counter-offer: marriage instead of death. Shinpei takes his vows seriously, and what begins as a trade for survival turns into something neither of them expected.
summaries.206163: A new entry in the Armored Trooper VOTOMS franchise, produced by Sunrise with production assistance from Production I.G as part of the studio's 50th-anniversary project slate running 2026 to 2028. Its listing doesn't yet describe the story or tone beyond this production background.
summaries.206189: The final season of Zhu Xian, bringing the series to its conclusion. No further plot details are given beyond it being the last season.
summaries.206270: The third season of Cang Yuan Tu, continuing the series from its earlier installments. No further plot details are provided in its listing.
summaries.206273: At the lowest point of the Celestial Realm's history, a crippled young man named Gu An seizes the power of an ancient god in a moment of life-or-death crisis. Armed with vast spiritual energy and an ordinary blade, he sets out to strike down evildoers, settle old scores, and defy the heavens themselves.
summaries.206282: Gu Feiyang, once the third-strongest warrior of the Tianwu Continent, finds his cultivation permanently capped by the world's own rules. To break free, he manipulates a rival sect's mistress into helping him orchestrate a reincarnation, sacrificing outside demonic energy to start over. Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a teenage heir to a powerful military family caught between foreign invasion and a succession struggle, he calmly navigates the chaos while secretly working toward a much larger goal.
summaries.206401: College student Kurumi Fukuda finally starts foreign exchange trading, determined to win back the 20 million yen her late mother lost in the markets. Confident she can make it all back easily, she instead discovers a volatile world where fortunes swing between euphoria and disaster in an instant. With her equally trading-obsessed friends along for the ride, the market becomes both their playground and their nightmare.
summaries.206523: Onegai AiPri is the newest chapter in the long-running AiPri series and the latest installment in the broader Pretty Series idol franchise. No further plot or character details are available yet, and its listed connections to other entries are still provisional and subject to change.
summaries.206774: Otaku high schooler Takumi is stunned to discover his computer's mouse cursor has somehow leapt out of the screen and into the real world, visible only to him. When his skeptical classmate Mone brushes off his claims, he realizes he can actually use the cursor to interact with the physical world around her. A gimmicky, screen-meets-reality romantic comedy built around an unusual power.
summaries.206814: Years after the battle with Majin Buu, Earth is enjoying a rare peace when Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from a long sleep. His reputation for annihilating entire planets puts even the gods on edge, and when he catches word of a Saiyan who once defeated Frieza, he seeks out Goku in person. An enhanced retelling of this arc's cosmic showdown between Goku's allies and the universe's most feared god.
summaries.206949: A legendary, undefeated warrior dies of old age, her only regret being that she never found an opponent strong enough to beat her. She wakes up reborn in the frail body of young noblewoman Nia Liston, far from battle-ready but given a second chance at the life she always wanted. Determined to get back to fighting form, she sets out to live, and if necessary die, on her own terms this time.
summaries.207084: In a remote mountain village called Kagami, old folklore warns children to behave or a Double will come for them. Middle schooler Akane Higure has spent a year waiting for her hospitalized older sister Sui to come home, but soon after Sui's return, Akane gets an unsettling phone call telling her that the girl in her house isn't really her sister.
summaries.207191: The Good Witch of the Lake, Rose, has a quiet crush on the dashing Sir Harij, so when he asks her to brew a love potion for someone else, her heart sinks. Still, the chance to spend time with him while gathering ingredients is hard to resist, even as their conversations stay painfully awkward. Things get more complicated when he starts showing up at her door uninvited, gifts in hand.
summaries.207217: Uunyan, an eager young kitten, is starting his first day as a delivery courier. The short follows him through the small rituals of the morning: getting dressed, having breakfast, packing his bag, with every little task becoming a new first-time challenge. It's a gentle, whimsical slice-of-life built around the simple charm of a tiny courier finding his footing.
summaries.207327: Transferring to a high school on a remote island to escape everyone who knows him, Kazuki Tsukigase hears local rumors about an inlet where people mysteriously vanish. Investigating it, he finds an unconscious girl who wakes with no memory of her identity except a name, an age, and a whispered year from decades past. A quiet mystery about time, isolation, and an unexplained connection between two strangers.
summaries.207329: Enchantment mage Rain Garland is suddenly cast out of his elite guild after years of loyal service, and in bitter response he reclaims every enhancement he'd placed on the guild's gear. Applying that power to his own sword and clothes instead reveals his magic is far more versatile, and far from maxed out, than anyone realized. Joined by a renowned knight and a noble aspiring hero, Rain begins building the adventuring career his old guild never let him have.
summaries.207809: A mysterious hand pulls modern Japanese teenager Yuri beneath a puddle, and she wakes up in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE, right in the middle of a bloody succession struggle. Alongside Prince Kail she has to dodge assassins and court conspiracies just to survive, eventually gaining a reputation as the goddess Ishtar. It's a historical fantasy about a girl caught between the ordinary life she left behind and the destiny she's stumbled into.
summaries.208025: Dark summoner Amona and uptight priest Roni should be natural enemies, but an impulsive one-night stand sets them on an unplanned enemies-to-lovers path instead. As the encounters keep happening, the two try to keep their relationship hidden from their adventuring party while refusing to admit how they really feel, all while a meddling imp takes far too much interest in their love life.
summaries.208105: Yani Neko Mini is a set of short, chibi-style videos spun off from the main Yani Neko series, released through its official YouTube channel and Twitter account. These bite-sized bonus clips are best enjoyed by fans already familiar with the original series rather than as a starting point.
summaries.208367: A sequel to Duel Masters LOST: Boukyaku no Taiyou, continuing that story within the Duel Masters franchise. Its listing provides no further plot or tone details.
summaries.209032: The second half of Mahou no Shimai LuluttoLilly, continuing directly from its first part. No further plot or tone details are given in its listing.
summaries.209219: Office worker Akira Yagami dies saving a child from being hit by a car, only to be reincarnated in another world as a goblin, a species that normally only survives a week. His unusual new powers let him defy that short lifespan, setting him on an unlikely path toward becoming the strongest goblin anyone has ever seen.
summaries.209463: Walking home from school one ordinary day, Noriko is suddenly pulled into a strange fantasy world, where she's rescued by the brave Izark. He turns out to be far more than he seems, carrying a darkness inside him that an old prophecy says only Noriko has the power to unleash. Bound together by fate, the two must find a way forward through a world that is both wondrous and dangerous.
summaries.209499: Shizuka takes on the deadliest assassination jobs in the business, but it's her brother Nagi who does the actual killing, at least until a bullet meant to protect her leaves him comatose and wheelchair-bound. Having discovered the one thing that might wake him, a surge of killing intent, Shizuka begins a brutal, high-stakes effort to bring her brother back by any means necessary.
summaries.209502: Classmates know Sato-san as cold and aloof, but only the narrator has seen the warm smile she hides from everyone else. Oshio-kun seems easygoing on the surface, but only the narrator knows how hard he works at his family's cafe after hours. A sweet, low-stakes romance about two people slowly discovering sides of each other no one else gets to see.
summaries.209562: Akira lives a quiet life with his older sister Haruka and their cafe-owning mother, unaware that Haruka secretly inherited their father's mysterious power called Engine. Akira, who never gained that same power, carries a quiet inferiority complex about it, until strange, unexplained events begin breaking out around the world.
summaries.209642: A compilation film gathering material from the Maebashi Witches television series into a single feature. Its listing gives no further plot or tone details beyond its format.
summaries.209872: The third season of the 2024 Ranma 1/2 anime, continuing its story from the previous seasons. No additional plot or tone details are included in its listing.
summaries.210482: The second and third stages of the transcontinental Steel Ball Run race send Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli across roughly 750 miles of desert known as the Devil's Palm, a stretch of land with an ominous, violent history. As strange incidents mount, it becomes clear the race hides motives far beyond simple competition. Tense, mystery-tinged action with the JoJo series' trademark blend of grit and spectacle.
summaries.211181: The fourth part of Mu Shen Ji, continuing the story from its previous installments. No additional plot details are given in its listing.
summaries.211220: Adapted from a novel, this story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised among demons, who is sent by his master to leave the Black-White Mountain and hunt down the three enemies responsible for the demons' downfall. As he searches for the truth, he begins uncovering the real history behind the human-demon conflict, the secrets of the ruling dynasty, and the truth about his own origins.
summaries.211778: After using her overpowered Internet skill to dismantle her former family's ambitions, witch Lorna is finally free to travel and enjoy herself. Her next stop, the port town of Aquas, turns out to be on the brink of disaster thanks to an urgent request, but with the gods apparently on her side, Lorna is more than equipped to handle whatever comes her way.
summaries.211877: A young man finally has a girlfriend for the first time, but finds himself increasingly tempted by her bold, flirtatious friend. A romantic drama built around temptation, jealousy, and the tension between loyalty and desire.
summaries.212144: The second season of Kizu darake Seijo yori Houfuku wo Komete, continuing its story from the first season. Its listing gives no further plot or tone details.
summaries.212309: A sequel to Transformers: Wild King, continuing the story introduced in that series. No further plot details are provided for this follow-up.
summaries.212503: As rival magic academies face off in the ongoing Magicks War, Ray and his friends find themselves confronting a far more serious threat lurking beneath the competition. The second season raises the stakes beyond school rivalry into something more dangerous for everyone involved.
summaries.212539: A theatrical compilation of all six episodes of Takopii no Genzai, recut into a single film with newly added scenes beyond the original series. Its listing doesn't otherwise describe plot or tone.
summaries.212799: At the center of a continent of eight kingdoms sits Marronnier, whose general Baribara has seven sons, each a knight commander with a unique gift. United by a shared vow to one day rescue a princess, the brothers set out as ambassadors to the kingdom's seven neighbors, each heading into his own unknown adventure.
summaries.212888: Sin Yeong-U, better known by his in-game name Grid, is a persistently unlucky, low-level player in the popular VR game Satisfy. When he stumbles onto a powerful item, he's granted a rare legendary class as a master blacksmith, able to forge unique, top-tier gear. Determined to turn his new skills into fame and fortune, he soon learns that standing out in a game this popular brings complications he didn't expect.
summaries.212969: Orphan Qin Yu earns a rare spot at Dongda Martial Academy, the region's top cultivation school. Beneath the city's peaceful surface, a demonic threat is quietly closing in, and Qin Yu resolves to lead his fellow students in standing against the coming invasion.
summaries.213068: Twenty years after the giant robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll and brought peace, the toy company that once thrived on Dandivine merchandise has fallen on hard times. When the Aposdoll inexplicably returns, high schooler Gekiha Shijima is recruited by his uncle, Dandivine's original pilot, to climb into the cockpit himself.
summaries.213102: Two seals, Eru and Aru, spend their days together in a warm, easygoing routine, playing at home, relaxing in front of the TV, and occasionally dozing off after wearing themselves out. A quiet, low-key slice-of-life series built around companionship and small comforts.
summaries.213188: On the Canglan Continent, strength is measured by one's martial spirit, and Qin Nan, heir to the Qin family, is written off early as talentless and mocked for it. A chance awakening links him to the soul of an ancient war god, setting him on a path past sect prodigies and powerful enemies alike, with an ally who becomes far more than a battle partner along the way.
summaries.213298: Based on Gakken's popular illustrated encyclopedia series, this adaptation turns bite-sized four-panel comics about animals and nature into a laid-back, fact-filled anime. A cute art style meets genuinely surprising trivia, making even unsettling creatures approachable and fun to learn about.
summaries.213356: The second season of Guangyin Zhi Wai, continuing on from the first. No additional plot or tone details are given in its listing.
summaries.213359: This is the seventeenth season of Yami Shibai, continuing the anthology's run of short entries. It's aimed at longtime viewers already familiar with the format rather than newcomers.
summaries.213426: Kikkun is an alien who traveled to Earth as part of an invasion force, but the team assigned to Japan finds the country so comfortable that they start to forget why they came. Rather than conquering it, they end up wanting to protect Japan and the planet instead. It's a lighthearted comedy about invaders who accidentally go native.
summaries.213427: This animated series is built around Lotte's Pie no Mi snack brand and releases on Lotte's official YouTube channel, with one new episode posted each month. It functions as ongoing promotional content tied to the snack rather than a traditional standalone story.
summaries.213428: Itoshi no Zako Haishinsha-chan is a yuri anime, meaning its central relationships are romantic ones between women, set against the modern backdrop of live streaming culture. Only that genre and setting are given, so plot specifics are unknown, but the combination suggests an intimate, character-focused romance layered over the world of online broadcasting rather than a plot-heavy drama. Its tone likely leans warm and slice-of-life.
summaries.213457: In a distant future where thick clouds block out the sun, oxygen is scarce and humanity has turned to a process that converts people into plants to slow the decline. Struggling to pay for his sick mother's medication, Toshiro Kamiya considers undergoing the irreversible transformation himself, forcing him to weigh what's left of his own humanity against his family's survival.
summaries.213486: The sixth season of You Shou Yan, continuing the series from its earlier installments. No further plot details are provided in its listing.
summaries.213657: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen, continuing directly from the first cour. No further plot or tone details are given in its listing.
summaries.213658: The second cour of the second season of Diamond no Ace act II, continuing directly from the first cour. Its listing provides no additional plot or tone details.
summaries.213703: Jiaonang Jihua: Qiji, or Capsules Project: Miracle, is a Chinese anthology of ten independently produced short animated films from a team of experienced animators. Built around the theme of extreme emotion paired with independent storytelling, each short is free to explore its own style and voice rather than fitting a single format. The project aims to spotlight original, varied short-form animation and help its creators reach an international audience.
summaries.213805: The ensemble of isolated, awkward teens, Koyuki, former idol Miki, boundary-blind Minato, and gentle basketball player Yota, continue their clumsy, heartfelt journey toward each other. As Koyuki and Minato's friendship edges toward something more and Yota finally voices feelings he's kept quiet for years, the group's crisscrossing emotions keep pulling them back together.
summaries.214074: Dream Arbeiter Baku is a short-form anime spin-off of the live-action tokusatsu series Kamen Rider Zeztz, distributed through Toei's official Tokusatsu Fan Club. Rather than telling a fully independent story, it's companion content built for existing fans of the live-action show, giving them extra animated material set alongside it.
summaries.214259: In this tenth installment of Yao Shen Ji, protagonist Nie Li journeys to the Demon God Sect, where he forms new friendships and begins a new chapter of his adventure. Driven by a resolve to challenge the ruling Holy Emperor and defend the City of Glory, this season continues the franchise's blend of found-family camaraderie and rising-power fantasy stakes for longtime fans of the series.
summaries.214260: Zeri Feisheng is set in a chaotic era overrun by demons and corrupt officials, where invading forces from the Netherworld terrorize humans and mortals alike. When a snake-catcher named Xu Ying is pushed to a breaking point and lashes out against those in power, he becomes a hunted man fleeing across both realms. The series leans into dark fantasy action and a persecuted-underdog framing as its hero runs for his life.
summaries.214536: An entry in the Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez franchise that first premiered in Japanese theaters on October 2, 2026, before being split into three episodes airing weekly on television starting November 7, 2026. Its listing gives no further plot or tone details beyond this release format.
summaries.214539: Stella Sora Anime PVs collects the animated promotional videos made for the smartphone game Stella Sora, rather than telling a continuous story of its own. Each short clip is styled to tease the game's world and characters, released periodically alongside the game's updates. It's aimed at players of Stella Sora looking for a glimpse of its cast in motion rather than viewers seeking a standalone narrative.
summaries.214829: Di Ling Ai: Shui Xin Chan continues its fantasy saga in the aftermath of a great war, as darkness and chaos spread across the world. Its ensemble of elemental Emperors and allies travel between realms searching for a way to seal the encroaching abyss, uncovering new threats and uneasy alliances along the way. The series keeps its focus on high-stakes fantasy conflict and whether faith and unity among its cast can hold against overwhelming odds.
summaries.214855: The fourth season of Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai, continuing the series from its earlier installments. No further plot details are given in its listing.
summaries.214968: The second season of the Nezumi-kun no Chokki television series, continuing from the first season. No further plot or tone details are given in its listing.
summaries.214974: Ten years after a mysterious blood moon ushered ghosts, gods, and strange omens into the world, humanity is left reeling between despair and defiance. Amid this eerie new order, a young man named Su Bai steps through the door into an extraordinary, dangerous new world. It's a moody fantasy setup built on mystery, dread, and the thrill of uncovering hidden powers.
summaries.215521: Zhangmen Didiao Dian follows Lu Chaoge, the young leader of a cultivation sect destroyed in a demonic surprise attack that costs him his family. Awakening a rare, heaven-defying cultivation system, he spends years training in isolation before a chance event reignites his growth. He sets out from the mountains with his younger sister to gather what he needs to break through his limits, driving a classic underdog cultivation comeback story.
summaries.215522: Caishen Dou Zhanlong opens with a Taoist inadvertently freeing a treasure-hoarding golden toad spirit while trying to read a heavenly text. Craving the prosperity of the mortal world, the toad reincarnates as a human named Dou Zhanlong, but to dodge a heavenly punishment it splits itself into nine souls scattered across nine parallel timelines. The series follows these parallel Dou Zhanlongs as each faces death and rebirth in turn, starting with the very first of the nine.
summaries.215526: Taigu Shen Zun follows a murdered spirit-realm prince who is reborn into the mortal world as a lowly servant, armed with a rare elixir and powerful cultivation techniques hidden beneath his humble station. Wielding little more than a rusty sword at first, he works his way up through the martial world's ranks, forming bonds with allies while facing down rivals from his past life. It's a classic revenge-and-cultivation power fantasy about a hidden prodigy clawing his way back to the top.
summaries.215835: Umayuru is a chibi-style short spotlighting the pint-sized cast of Uma Musume. This installment centers on a "Full Gate" race, where every one of the Uma Musume lines up together on the track at once for a lighthearted, three-minute dash. It's a breezy, super-sized gathering built for fans who enjoy seeing the whole roster in one place.
summaries.216557: A new anime entry in the long-running Keroro Gunsou franchise. Its listing gives no further detail about plot, characters, or tone.
summaries.216620: Zhang Yuanqing's ordinary life is upended when a mysterious black card transforms him into a Night Wandering Deity, drawing him into the workings of strange and unpredictable Spiritual Realms. He's soon caught between two rival camps locked in a long-running struggle over justice and wrongdoing. The setup leans into conspiracy and intrigue, promising a world where alliances and motives are rarely what they first appear.
summaries.216643: Matsuken and his dog partner Matsu Inu take on the small, hazy frustrations of everyday modern life, cheerfully working to chase them away. The tone is warm and upbeat rather than dramatic, built around brief, feel-good encounters rather than an ongoing plot. It's the kind of show meant to be dipped into for a quick, lighthearted pick-me-up.
summaries.216860: The fourth season of Punirunes, continuing the series from its earlier seasons. No further plot or tone details are included in its listing.
summaries.216895: Welsh, a country boy who loves to cook, crosses paths with Shedar, a young prince destined for the throne. Despite their very different worlds, the two are drawn together by chance and find themselves working side by side to stop a tyrant bent on conquering the land. It plays as an odd-couple adventure built on an unlikely friendship, blending warm slice-of-life charm with higher-stakes political fantasy.
summaries.217246: At Jixia College, a group of standout alumni return as temporary substitute teachers, with fan favorites like Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang Zhan facing off against the current students in playful dual-teacher showdowns. Daily life becomes a mix of comic mishaps and warm mentor-student banter, until an unexpected crisis pushes everyone to team up. It continues the series light, found-family tone as returning seniors and their juniors fight side by side.
summaries.217282: The second season of GelPiyo, continuing on from the first. Its listing gives no additional plot or tone details.
summaries.217577: Mazenchu unfolds in a school for anthropomorphized food, where various dishes and ingredients navigate the ordinary dramas of youth: budding friendships, petty rivalries, and romances that do not always go smoothly. The premise leans into a whimsical, slice-of-life tone, finding charm in giving snack-aisle characters real teenage emotional stakes.
summaries.217624: The fourth season of PetitCure: Precure Fairies, continuing the series from its earlier seasons. No further plot or tone details are given in its listing.
summaries.217628: The seventh season of Wanmei Shijie, covering episodes 287 through 338 of the long-running series. Its listing gives no further plot or tone details beyond that episode range.
summaries.217782: Kanojo no Tomodachi Mini Anime is a short companion series paired with each episode of Kanojo no Tomodachi, airing on the AT-X broadcast and streaming via OceanVeil. It's a bite-sized extra rather than a standalone story, built for viewers already following the main show. A good pick if you want a little more of that show's world between episodes.
summaries.218011: Tanuki to Kitsune follows the easygoing daily life of a good-natured but scatterbrained raccoon dog and the playful fox who loves teasing him, two close friends who share a home on a quiet mountain. Their circle widens with a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and assorted birds, giving the show a warm, ensemble slice-of-life feel. It's a cozy, low-stakes comedy built on friendship and gentle animal antics rather than any dramatic turns.
